_comment: Deployable cells of the Stronghold Protocol map, in the camera view used while an operator is being dragged (1920x1080).
col: counted from the right, the red-gate column is NOT counted (col 1 is the first column left of the red gates).
row: counted from the top of the map. tag 'safe' = wooden-frame platform (enemies do not walk there), 'path' = floor tile on the enemy route.
region: operators are only deployed to cells inside these column/row ranges (default: columns 2-4, rows 1-3).
order: preferred filling order inside the region; max_operators is the game's limit of 8 operators on the field.
c4r3, c5r2, c5r3 hold barrier crates (阻隔工事) and are not deployable; inside the region that leaves exactly 8 cells.
